name: python_syntax_static
command: harness/bin/python3 -c import ast, pathlib, subprocess, sys; files=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","*.py"], text=True).splitlines(); bad=[]; skipped=[] for f in files:     if "/vendor/" in f or f.startswith("harness/vendor/"):         skipped.append(f); continue     try:         ast.parse(pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=f)     except Exception as e:         bad.append((f, str(e))) print(f"python files parsed={len(files)-len(skipped)} skipped_vendor={len(skipped)} bad={len(bad)}") for f,e in bad[:50]: print(f"BAD {f}: {e}") sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
